profile.headline: Software Developer at NYISO
profile.geoLocationName: New Lebanon, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of successfully completing challenging assignments on schedule.  Skilled at working with web applications using Java, Javascript, and SQL or MongoDB databases.   Most recently have worked on several complex systems used by General Electric to support it's IT infrastructure .

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
One AD Active Directory Team, GE Global Research

Migrated approximately 1,000 Linux servers off multiple domains in American, Europe, and Asia and onto a single common domain.   Changed the authentication service from Likewise to Dell Authentication Services (DAS).

High Performance Computing Team, GE Global Research    

Enhanced the High Performance Application Launcher module that submitted  jobs to the Portable Batch System, a scheduling package for HPC.  The new module assigned clusters and CPU's, MPI threads and processes, resources and queues, based on the type of submission request.  HAL simplified the setup of HPC jobs for GE engineering community.

Created consolidated site metrics for all five of GE's HPC Data Centers.  Charts and tables showed Cray and Linux system availability, resource usage, and queuing time awaiting resources.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
GE Digital Core Tech Solutions, GE Corporate

Lead Support for Amanda, a Java EE application that showed the availability and status of all GE servers, virtual machines, and network devices.  Data came from five  resource monitors:  HP Openview, Opsware and Sitescope, CA Spectrum, and VMware vROps.   Amanda was also used to "silence servers",  stopping them from issuing monitoring alerts when a device is taken down for maintenance.   Performance graphs and charts were also available.

Introduced major performance enhancements.  Sped up queries by implementing server-side page of data table output when viewing large collections.   Sped up the five dial "Monitoring Agent Coverage" dashboard by populating the dial search criteria at  load time.  Fixed deadlocking issues around large batches of silencing transactions by atomizing the updates.

Added Vitual Machine monitoring using data from VMware. Created a dashboard dial, search and display functions, performance graphs, and batch updates.   Retrieved VMware resource properties, and ported VM Reports directly into Amanda.

Renewables Computer Center Team, GE Power & Water

Enhanced AgI, a Java EE application that spins up new VM's on an internal GE Cloud.   Set up the app so it would automatically add an asset in GE Service Now and an identity in Active Directory when a VM was created.   Used the HornetQ  message queuing service within JBoss to asynchronously post these transactions, so as to not slow up the  workflow.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed custom XML products for major media companies around TV data.  Created the "Enhanced Content" product, which combined content for all levels of a scheduled TV program, including episode, show, season, and series into a single XML file.  Created the "Advanced Planner" TV listing forecasting system.  Refined Product tiers and categories.

Posted show and celebrity photos associated with the TV data products.  Ran photo conversions to load a new Digital Asset Management editing system.

Set up applications to run in parallel development, QA, and production environments.  Documented systems on the corporate Wiki.  Provided after hours support as part of an on-call team.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed Search Engine Optimization reports which monitored client website visibility.  Enhanced the Ninja Tools which support the business.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed the Trading Simulator, an animated stock charting application.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: With a team developed CMD Connect, a web based product that gave customers access to their Construction Market Data Reports.
